core_obligations: Compare local rings: a smooth presentation of the source gives an isomorphism type comparison between the local ring of the stack at the point and that of the presentation, and the same for the target (proof lines 5526-5535)

Apply the scheme-free criterion: for a presentation of the morphism the local ring map is flat at the relevant point, which by the criterion for algebraic spaces is equivalent to flatness at a point in the stack sense (proof lines 5536-5545)
Conclude by locality: since flatness at a point is local in the smooth topology on both source and target, the two statements are equivalent for the morphism of stacks (proof lines 5546-5558)
proof_roadmap: 取源与目标的满光滑展示，把栈上点处的局部环与展示概型上点处的局部环对应起来。
在展示层面用代数空间的「平坦点 = 局部环平坦」判据。
由平坦性在光滑拓扑下对源与目标都局部，得栈上该点平坦 ⟺ 展示上对应点平坦。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that flatness at a point of a morphism of algebraic stacks is equivalent to flatness of the induced map of local rings at corresponding points, expressed through presentations (author lemma at source lines 5498-5524, label lemma-flat-at-point). The proof (source lines 5526-5559) compares the local rings of the stack and of a presentation, applies the corresponding criterion for algebraic spaces and uses the locality of flatness in the smooth topology to conclude (proof lines 5526-5558). The comparison of local rings through a presentation is the substance. H3.
